material_extras.astraBaseMaterial: Original semantic material name, e.g. Porcelain white

fallback.meaning: Original semantic behavior, not a blanket architecture classification

name_policy: Preserve original material.name where possible; all semantic classification must still use the base-name bridge
zone_source: mesh then parent chain userData.zone; never infer from shared material
extras_destination: glTF.materials[].extras -> material.userData; do not assume primitive.extras populates material
component_definition: Production assemblyComponents() on the pinned/current GLTFLoader-loaded v1 geometry, including all POSITION vertices and local-coordinate rounding at 1e-4
mixed_or_ambiguous_component_policy: Keep original material and record unresolved visual scope; never expand selection to adjacent architecture
attribute_policy: Copy all actual vertex attributes via explicit source-to-output mapping, retain original local float values and triangle winding/multiplicity
verification_notes: World comparison tolerance only covers explained transform rounding; 1e-4 local welding grid is not permitted geometry movement.
Run createBuildingEntrance() on actual GLTFLoader results and inspect temporary attributes before finish().
tick(delta) caps each delta at 50ms; do not assume a single multi-second tick advances all the way.
Rotated node AABBs may change when primitives split; preserve unsplittable primitives if production bounds differ.
Original unused vertices require explicit analysis; skip split if equivalent behavior cannot be preserved.
Record actual primitive, draw-call and assembly shadow-draw deltas; no hard promise of +3.
lightmap_dependency: Reuse lighting-v1 maps only with verified unchanged UV1; otherwise publish and validate complete paired model/map set
zone_normalization: Known original land has no raw zone and normalizes to ground; seven building zones must retain mesh/ancestor identity.
applicability: Role semantics and evidence required; derivative asset pipeline only if current assets do not already contain equivalent verified roles.
